note: Umair et al. (2025) describe ambiguous speech rather than absolute aphonia linked to vocal cord involvement in NAV3-related NDD (OMIM #621182).

evidence.text: The study associates a homozygous NAV3 variant with ambiguous speech linked to vocal cord involvement confirmed via flexible laryngoscopy and vocal EMG in the context of OMIM #621182.

source.title: NAV3 Missense Variant in a Homozygous State: Strengthening Links to Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: is ambiguous speech linked to vocal cord involvement, confirmed through flexible laryngoscopy and vocal EMG — findings not widely described in previous NAV3-
